findingsForConductor: P-04 says both draft paths 'save each answer'. The device draft does (every change is stored in the tab). The account draft saves only when the person presses Save draft, and warns before leaving with unsaved changes. The tests pin what exists; the spec line is wrong for the account path or the product must change.

/fairs and /fairs/<slug> answer 404 when CORRIDRA_UX_FAIRS is off (the verification server default). That is pinned as 'plain not found, never an error'. Their on-behaviour (links to /plan?job=trade_fairs) is not pinned: the verification server does not set the switch and I may not change it.
